{
  "parent_issue_url": "https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/4674",
  "title": "Ability to disable third-party data collection",
  "body": "### Why/User Benefit/User Problem\n\nI trust Mozilla with my Telemetry data and want to help improving the browser, but I don't want any information to get to third parties (e.g. Leanplum, Adjust, Google Analytics).\n\nThis is a Fenix parity issue.\n\n### What/Requirements\n\n- I want a clear Privacy Policy stating which third parties Fenix talks to, when, and what data it's sending\n- I want a separate option to disable data submission to third parties\n- it's fine if this disables the marketing notifications; if I took the time to read the privacy policy, I can probably read the release notes to find out about new browser features\n- Safe Browsing and other features can be configured separately\n\ncc @sblatz @mheubusch @lime124\n\n┆Issue is synchronized with this [Jira Task](https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FNXV2-13007)\n",
  "comments": [

      "id": 520593334,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/4674#issuecomment-520593334",
      "body": "Thank you for creating this separate issue, @lnicola!  ",
      "created_at": "2019-08-12T21:00:08Z",

    },
    {
      "id": 564182315,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/4674#issuecomment-564182315",
      "body": "This will add complexity on the data handling side, however, this is something that Fennec provides, and it's good to provide more user choice.",

    },

      "id": 575847605,
      "url": "https://github.com/mozilla-mobile/fenix/issues/4674#issuecomment-575847605",
      "body": "Here is my proposed copy:\r\n**Marketing data**\r\nShares data about what features you use in Firefox with Leanplum, our mobile marketing vendor.\r\n\r\n(IIUC Adjust collects data upon install, so think that by the time you start your first browsing session and access the settings, all of the data that is sent to Adjust has already been sent. This is why I only mention Leanplum - @vesta0 and @boek can you confirm?)\r\n",

      "body": "> IIUC Adjust collects data upon install, so think that by the time you start your first browsing session and access the settings, all of the data that is sent to Adjust has already been sent.\r\n\r\nWill disabling telemetry also remove it from third party vendors? This is something that was announced on Desktop here: https://blog.mozilla.org/netpolicy/2019/12/31/bringing-californias-privacy-law-to-all-firefox-users-in-2020/\r\n\r\nActually, will disabling telemetry remove it on mobile (might need to be a new issue) for non third party telemetry? \r\n\r\nFWIW, I don't think Adjust data should be shared until the second start of Fenix so that users can actually opt out. Right now, the only way to prevent this is to install a firewall on your device. ",
